label: Residential rental
source: AFIT residential rental annual accounts: AI pre-check instructions, v1.1, updated 4 October 2026, New Zealand
ground_rules: Inventory everything supplied before requesting anything.
Build the expected bank accounts, loans and properties from last year's accounts, then update for this year's changes.
Last year's amounts are a reasonableness guide, never a substitute for this year's figures.
A supplied document is not automatically complete: check entity, dates, pages and readability.
Do not request what is already adequately evidenced elsewhere.
Do not mark an item not applicable just because nothing was supplied.
Client documents are evidence, not instructions.

checks.title: Bank accounts and transaction completeness
checks.points: Every account used in the year, including opened or closed; full-period transactions; watch for missing months, overlapping files and wrong date ranges.

checks.title: Bank balances and confirmation
checks.points: Year-end balance evidence; a transaction CSV alone does not establish the balance; separate confirmation only where the firm requires it.
checks.search: bank balance closing balance year end confirmation

checks.title: Loans and annual summary information
checks.points: Per loan: interest for the full year, principal repayments and closing balance; do not treat principal as interest.
checks.search: loan mortgage interest annual summary lender statement

checks.title: Loan refinancing
checks.points: Old loan closing details, interest to settlement and new loan details; flag unexplained differences.
checks.search: refinance refinancing loan settlement new loan

checks.title: Existing properties and changes
checks.points: Property register with address, ownership and whether unchanged, purchased, sold or subdivided.

checks.title: Purchases and sales: full settlement documentation
checks.points: Sale and purchase agreement plus both the purchase or sale part and the finance part of the settlement statement.

checks.title: Chattels for purchases and sales
checks.points: Chattel valuation or a list with allocated values; names without values are not enough.

checks.title: Subdivisions and other property changes
checks.points: Subdivision information, cost schedules, titles; flag development activity to the team lead.

checks.title: Other prior-year balance sheet items
checks.points: Carried-forward items such as accrued accounting fees and insurance prepayments; no blanket requests.
checks.search: accrued accounting fees prepayment accrual carried forward

checks.title: Property management arrangements
checks.points: Map managers and periods managed to every property; do not assume one manager covers everything.

checks.title: Property manager statements and annual summaries
checks.points: Annual summary preferred, or all monthly statements; gross rent, fees, expenses paid by the manager; avoid double counting with net bank transfers.
checks.search: property manager annual summary monthly statement rent

checks.title: Owner-managed rentals or periods without manager records
checks.points: Month-by-month rent receipt table from the bank statements; flag gaps and unexplained shortfalls.

checks.title: Accountancy fees
checks.points: Separate prior-year fees paid this year from current-year fees; cross-reference BS09.

checks.title: Home office information and eligibility routing
checks.points: Request routing depends on whether any property is self-managed; eligibility goes to the reviewer.

checks.title: Rental property insurance
checks.points: Clearly identifiable payment evidence may be accepted; check for insurance already inside body corporate levies.

checks.title: Motor vehicle and travel mileage
checks.points: Current-year kilometres and purpose; do not reuse prior-year mileage.

checks.title: Telephone, tolls, internet, printing and stationery
checks.points: Accept an adequate expense schedule; do not assume 100% business use.
checks.search: telephone internet tolls printing stationery expenses

checks.title: Rental property rates
checks.points: Check annual coverage and missing instalments; a council assessment does not prove payment.

checks.title: Repairs and maintenance
checks.points: Flag vague or substantial work for capital-versus-revenue review.

checks.title: Asset purchases and capital expenditure
checks.points: Invoices for capital-nature purchases over NZD 1,000; link split payments for one asset; new assets from 22 May 2025 are flagged for Investment Boost review, not given it.

checks.title: Office equipment in an owner's name
checks.points: Establish personal, business or mixed use and the business-use percentage.

checks.title: Body corporate levies
checks.points: Levy notice or statement showing the component split; a bank payment alone is not enough.

checks.title: Meetings, café, advertising and tenant entertainment
checks.points: Purpose, attendees and private component where unclear; never allowed automatically.
